ela-middle.note: NJSLA Levels 4–5, weighted by 37 published valid scores. Accelerated course exams are reported separately. Suppressed grades remain unavailable.

district-spending.label: District spending per pupil
district-spending.note: Audited actual district total spending per pupil from NJDOE’s 2025 Taxpayers’ Guide. Same district value for every school; not school-specific. Includes district-paid costs for students sent elsewhere.
